resources.string: Keep your Android device open and user-controlled.

The campaign says a planned Google developer-verification system could require registration, fees, government ID and signing-key details before apps can be installed on certified Android devices. It warns that this may limit sideloading, independent developers, F-Droid and user choice, and asks people to support an open Android ecosystem.
KeepDroid is active as a device administrator. You can disable it at any time in system settings.
Activate device administrator to make KeepDroid available as a visible, user-controlled administrator.
KeepDroid does not hide its status or prevent removal. Device administrator activation is always confirmed by Android system settings.
KeepDroid provides a visible device administrator entry for the user.
